chunks.text: MOT Plus MK is your local full service garage and automotive shop. We are fast, professional and reliable!

MOT Plus MK is an independently-owned automotive shop in Bletchley, Milton Keynes. Providing you the highest level of service in all areas of our expertise and going the extra mile to give you an unparalleled level of assistance you won’t find anywhere else.

Having your vehicle in a garage for an MOT or service can be a stressful experience, which is why we go above and beyond to make the process as smooth and stress-free as possible. We keep our clients informed throughout the repair process and are always available to answer any questions or concerns they may have. No matter what type of vehicle you drive, our team has the knowledge to provide you with the best possible service.
Many years of auto repair experience have made us experts in our industry. Our timely and quality services include, but are not limited.
If your car’s MOT is due for testing, give us a call at MOT Plus MK and our friendly and professional team will help you.
Need new tyres or are unsure if your tyres need changing? Get in touch with us and we will be happy to check your tyres.
At MOT Plus MK, we offer a comprehensive range of car repairs and garage services. All work is carried out to the highest standards.
We service cars of all ages and models. Using genuine and approved parts, we ensure your vehicle is taken care of – fair and honest prices.
If a warning light shows on your dashboard, get in touch with us swiftly. At our garage in Milton Keynes, we can diagnose issues early to avoid serious problems.
Oil is one of he most important part of your car’s engine. Changing car oil regularly will result in a healthy and reliable engine. Book today to have your oil drained and replaced.
MOT Plus MK is committed to providing efficient, reliable and consistent service and products to our customer by qualified and competent professional mechanics.
We are dedicated to meeting the needs of our long time customers as well as new customers by maintaining relationships that are based on honesty, communication, trust and 100% satisfaction.

MOT Plus MK is a leading independent garage in Milton Keynes, providing high quality vehicle repairs and servicing for most makes and models of cars – from our fully equipped garage workshop in Bletchley.

We are your local MOT testing centre for petrol and diesel cars. Only when you are satisfied, are we satisfied and we are extremely proud that we are recommended by many and have repeat customers coming to us for all their car related repairs and services.

Not sure about tyre pressure or the noise that is coming from your car when driving? Can’t remember when your service or MOT is due? We can remind you when your service and MOT are due. We can help you with vehicle servicing and repairs.
We are your local friendly and professional mechanics down your road. We not only just fix cars. We fix them with smiles as a standard.
5 Clarke Road, Bletchley, Milton Keynes, MK1 1LG
Over the years, I have always received the most excellent services from MOT Plus MK and their team. Nothing was too much trouble for them and they always go out of their way. I highly recommend them.

MOT Plus MK are a DVSA approved MOT testing centre for Bletchley, Milton Keynes and the surrounding areas. Our team of friendly and experienced MOT technicians will ensure that your Class 4 or Class 7 MOT tests are done to the highest standards and at competitive prices.

Your vehicle needs an annual MOT test once a year, carried out up to a month before the expiry date (the expiry date of the MOT will not change). These checks are done to ensure your vehicle is roadworthy and safe to drive. A valid MOT certificate is a legal requirement in the UK for most vehicles over three years old, including both hybrid and electric vehicles.

If your car or van needs an MOT test, or you are unsure when your MOT is due, give our friendly team at MOT Plus MK in Milton Keynes a call and we will take care of the rest. We can carry out class 4 & 7 MOT test at our DVSA-approved workshop in Bletchley. If you have any concerns about anything on your vehicle that might be a issue on an MOT test, it is advisable to book a service at the same time to ensure that potential issues are dealt with before the test, saving you money and time! Securely book your MOT online or give us a call .

Book your MOT test online quickly and securely at a date and time that is convenient for you. The team at MOT Plus MK garage is ready to offer you advice and assistance the next time you wish to book your annual MOT test with us.

The MOT test examines a range of essential vehicle components, and depending on their condition, the result may be either a pass or a fail. However, the test does not assess the general state of the engine, clutch, or gearbox.
